court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 12.04.2013. Two female children were born from the wedlock. The petitioner seeks to transfer the case to the III Additional Principal Family Court at Chennai.

legal_principles.principle: Where the wife pleads lack of money, it has to be considered.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Supreme Court has held that where the petitioner's wife has pleaded lack of money, the same has to be considered.
cited_cases: Geeta Heera vs. Harish Chander Heera, (2000) 10 SCC 304
use_in: divorce cases where financial constraints are involved

legal_principles.principle: The intention of the Legislator is to safe-guard the interest and rights of women who are being subjected to harassment and cruelty.
legal_principles.held: The intention of the Legislator is to safe-guard the interest and rights of the women, who are being subjected to harassment and cruelty.
cited_cases: Lalita A.Ranga vs. Ajay Champalal Ranga, (2000) 9 SCC 355
use_in: cases involving domestic violence or harassment

legal_principles.principle: The Courts will not allow the father to shift his responsibility of maintenance of the minor child.
legal_principles.held: Even in the absence of any application, the Court will not allow the father to shift his responsibility of maintenance of the minor child.
cited_cases: Archana Singh vs. Surendra Bahadur Singh, (2005) 12 SCC 395
use_in: cases involving child custody and maintenance

legal_principles.principle: The interest of the minor child is to be protected by the Courts.
legal_principles.held: Whenever a minor child is with the custody of the unemployed mother, even in case if the mother is employed, the father is liable to maintain the minor child and the Courts will not allow the father to shift his responsibility of maintenance of the minor child.
cited_cases: Archana Singh vs. Surendra Bahadur Singh, (2005) 12 SCC 395
use_in: cases involving child custody and maintenance

outcome.final_order: The transfer petition is filed to withdraw the case in O.P.No.6 of 2022 and tried along with O.P.No.4810 of 2022.

use_for_drafting: drafting transfer petition for divorce case
advising on jurisdictional issues in family court cases
assisting with matrimonial disputes involving minor children
